pages.title: reconstruction_architecture_p21_v2
pages.description: Create a corrected version of the reference figure with five visually separated columns. COLUMN 1 INPUTS: top Sparse wells, black well points labelled {(s_i,z_i)}; bottom Registered 3-D context, one realistic seismic cube with inline, crossline and time axes, labelled X. COLUMN 2 TWO INDEPENDENT PATHS: the sparse wells alone enter a blue Ordinary kriging module containing a variogram glyph and z_OK(s_0)=sum_i lambda_i z_i; the registered 3-D context alone enters an orange Frozen OpenMind-MAE module with lock icon, 3-D patches, Patch embedding, four ResEncL stages and output U in R^(N x 96). There must be no arrow from ordinary kriging to OpenMind-MAE. Beneath the foundation model show Train-only scaling and PCA, with u_i=PCA(Std(U_i)). COLUMN 3 FOUNDATION-INFORMED METRIC: a teal Metric builder receives coordinates and well values from the sparse-well path, registered seismic attributes from the 3-D context, and PCA latent u_i from the foundation path. Show only this compact equation: m_s(s_i)=[x_i,y_i,4z_i,s a_i,0.1u_i]. Split into exactly three aligned branches labelled s=0, s=0.1 and s=0.2. Every branch contains 64-NN, a neighborhood graph, d^(-1.5) weighting and Local kernel k_s. COLUMN 4 FIXED FUSION: merge the three local kernels in a Fixed mean node, then combine that mean with the blue ordinary-kriging prediction at a Blend node. Show only this exact formula below the node: z_hat=0.25 z_OK+0.75 mean_s k_s. COLUMN 5 OUTPUTS: show exactly three different green scientific outputs, each once: Porosity volume as a 3-D scalar field, Orthogonal slices as three crossing planes, Directional variograms as a polar or directional line diagnostic. Do not repeat Orthogonal slices. BOTTOM EVALUATION STRIP: Spatial 5-fold | 512 train labels/fold | 2,048 validation points/fold | Frozen backbone | Same-field historical transfer. Connect it only to evaluation brackets, not to forward arrows. Use short labels only. Spell every label correctly. Omit the phrases compact glyph, compact dimensions, compact trons, scientific method and baseline volume. Also omit LoRA, Adapter, residual head, cross-attention, consistency gate, learned gate, per-fold selection, ablation and performance claims. Make the orange pretrained representation and the teal three-kernel ensemble the visual focus.
